mechanism_narrative: High inflation as measured by CPIAUCSL compresses real interest rates and increases equity risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days. This mechanism is always active and does not require a threshold condition to activate the signal.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 240, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, increasing the risk of recession and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength (PAYEMS) exceeds 145000 and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240, it signals that the Federal Reserve will aggressively tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (PAYEMS>145000 AND CPIAUCSL>240) produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals that the Federal Reserve will maintain an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 (thousands of units), it signals a weakening economy and increased risk of recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in the real economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1250 and retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 470000 (millions of dollars), it signals a weak consumer demand environment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST<1250 AND RSAFS<470000) produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP (GDPC1) falls below 16800 (billions of chained 2017 dollars), it signals a slowing economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 16800, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
